description: This source file implements a scheduling class for CuteDSL (CUTLASS Python DSL) kernels within PyTorch's _inductor backend. It contains methods for identifying CuteDSL nodes, generating kernel code, and managing kernel caching. The class also supports code generation for CuteDSL templates, although fusion features are currently unimplemented.

classes.name: CuteDSLScheduling
classes.description: A scheduling class for managing CuteDSL kernels within the PyTorch _inductor backend, supporting kernel code generation and template handling.

methods.name: OrderedSet[BackendFeature] get_backend_features(cls, device)
methods.description: Returns the backend features supported, currently an empty set.

methods.name: bool is_cutedsl_template(node: BaseSchedulerNode)
methods.description: Checks if a node is a CuteDSL template node.

methods.name: bool is_cutedsl_fused_template(self, node: BaseSchedulerNode)
methods.description: Checks if a node is a fused CuteDSL template node.

methods.name: bool can_fuse_vertical( self, node1: BaseSchedulerNode, node2: BaseSchedulerNode )
methods.description: Determines if vertical fusion can be performed between two nodes (currently always False).

methods.name: str define_kernel(self, src_code_str: str, node_schedule)
methods.description: Generates, caches, and returns the kernel name for a given source code string and node schedule.

methods.name: codegen_template( self, template_node: BaseSchedulerNode, epilogue_nodes: Sequence[BaseSchedulerNode], prologue_nodes: Sequence[BaseSchedulerNode], )
methods.description: Generates code for a CuteDSL template node, asserting no fusion with epilogue or prologue nodes.
